issues.claim: ONE FIX WITH VPC-R5-02 (verify-pipeline-r5t), found independently from V06's side. Under R5-02 a wall stretch laid after a raised way runs on beneath its deck, each support, ramp, stair, foot or `vault` span in its band taken into the line (§2.7's support step (6) (d), base l. 2603-2614; V06 §3.7.6 (5)). §4.11's `wallToWay` (l. 8214-8221) makes the ring road by `retypeEdges` 'on the same edges'; its only raised-way clause is the stretch under a crossing station. V06 §3.7.6 (5)'s absorb bullet says only that the new ring road takes no junction with a raised way. So at the pathway's `road` fate (V06 §3.7.2 (3), l. 1486) or a hand `convert` `wallToWay` of a ring laid after a raised way, nothing says how the road passes it. Taken literally, the primary way's spine runs over the support rings and through a `vault` span's chamber, against (6) (a) ('everything laid after the raised way gives way to it') and against T110-2's and T-V6-47's bar '0 way corridors over a support ring, ramp, stair, foot or `vault` span'. The path is ordinary: a CITY whose S4 viaduct is crossed by stage 2's ring (T110-2's c14 fixture), that ring later superseded with fate `road`. Builders diverge (through the pier, ended at the strip, bent under a span); no bar runs it.
issues.required_change: Apply VPC-R5-02's required change (§4.11 `wallToWay`'s added sentence, with its V06 ends at §3.7.6 (5)'s bullet and T-V6-47): one fix, no second text for the base. Name the fixture VPC-R5-02 leaves open: T-V6-47 (and V06 §7's T110-2 row) adds 'and `wallToWay` of H-AQUA's METROPOLIS circuit, which runs on beneath its aqueduct and its timber elevated road, by a hand `convert` after the contraction and, on a second run, by its pathway fate set to `road` by a hand `setAttr` — the ring road crossing each under-deck strip under a span §4.3 admits, else ended at the strip's edges, the raised ways unchanged — 0 way corridors over a support ring, ramp, stair, foot or `vault` span'. §2.7's support step (6) (a)'s list adds ', the ring road `wallToWay` makes (§4.11)' after 'a hand way'.

issues.claim: ONE FIX WITH VEW-r5-02 (verify-edges-world-r5t), found independently from V06's side. Under R5-02 a wall stretch laid after a raised way is closed against each support, ramp, stair, foot or `vault` span in its band, ends at a `vault` span's two walled-up arch mouths, and beneath every other span is a run topped at the soffit, derived at read (§2.7's support step (6) (d), base l. 2603-2614; V06 §3.7.6 (5); T-V6-47; V07 §3.5a (4)). Those parts then go on ordinary paths: V06 §3.19.2 (3)'s salvage `dismantle` clears a support whose spans have fallen (only a crossing station's is spared, and a support a later wall abuts is none), a span's arch-vault chambers collapse with it in the same batch (l. 2932), §3.11.4's `topple` breaks both spans beside a support, and a hand `delete` removes the whole raised way. Nothing says what the wall's line becomes across the former part (a gap, a `breached` run or a run standing whole), nor what height the run has once its span is ruined, cleared or removed. This is reached on H-AQUA itself: its METROPOLIS circuit runs on beneath its aqueduct, which runs dry in year 170, lapses, falls by span and is salvaged. Builders diverge on the wall's condition, closure, drawing and glTF height; no bar runs it.
issues.required_change: Apply VEW-r5-02's required change at §2.7's support step (6) (d), in whichever outcome the adjudicator rules there (the run whole across the former footprint and at full height beneath a fallen span, or a `breached` run whose one writer is the op that removes the part), with its rendering, V06 §3.19.2 (3)-(4) and scope T110-2 (4) ends: one fix. Add the V06 test end VEW-r5-02 does not list, since V06 runs T110-2's epoch clauses (4) and (5) in T-V6-47 (§13.2's runs sentence; V06 §7's T110-2 row): T-V6-47 and §7's T110-2 row add on H-AQUA 'after its METROPOLIS circuit ran on beneath the standing aqueduct, the aqueduct run dry (year 170) and lapsed — a `vault` span in the circuit's band breached (its chamber collapsing) and a support in the band cleared by V06 §3.19.2 (3) — and, on a second run, the timber elevated road deleted by hand: the run across each former part and beneath each fallen span as §2.7's support step (6) (d) rules, the circuit's closure unchanged, the delete's undo restoring the abutments and the cap'. T-V6-47's bar cell adds the ruled outcome's bar ('0 gaps in a band' if whole, or each former footprint `breached` in the removing op's batch).

issues.claim: The amended H-AQUA definition (V06 §7, l. 4063-4074) states the conditions under which 'the founding lays' its viaduct: the valley deeper than `viaduct.minDropM`, and `chance` and `pMax` raised to 1. These are not enough. (a) V06 §3.19 (2) (l. 2776-2777) also requires the span within `viaduct.maxSpanM` and the strength `saved − span × viaduct.spanCostFactor` above 0. With V11's factor of 4, the main approach road's ground course from `A` to `B` must be more than five times `|AB|`. §3.19 (5) also drops a course past `raisedWays.structure.maxPierM` or `maxClearSpanM`. A road crossing its valley nearly straight founds nothing. The repair added `pMax` for this very reason but missed these. (b) T-V6-47 (l. 4170) runs 'a viaduct a later trace meets gets no gate', yet the definition lays the METROPOLIS circuit across the elevated road only. Whether a later trace meets the viaduct (from `A` just inside the CITY ring to `B` beyond the valley) depends on growth the definition does not fix. The elevated road does not stand in for it: the viaduct carries the main approach road, a primary, so it is the case where the gate law must read the crossing on ground part 0 and pin no gate on the deck. This is R5-10's class (a test names a case its fixture need not hold); a build agent tunes the recipe, so nothing built changes.
issues.required_change: V06 §7's H-AQUA definition: '(the recipe's valley deeper than `viaduct.minDropM`, its rim at the ring's foot so that the reading's `A` lies inside the ring, V06 §3.19 (2);' → '(the recipe's valley deeper than `viaduct.minDropM`, its rim at the ring's foot so that the reading's `A` lies inside the ring, the main approach road's ground course from `A` to `B` longer than (1 + `viaduct.spanCostFactor`) × `|AB|` with `|AB|` within `viaduct.maxSpanM` so that the reading's strength is above 0, and its piers and clear spans within `raisedWays.structure.maxPierM` and `maxClearSpanM`, V06 §3.19 (2), (5); its far foot `B` beyond the land the METROPOLIS epoch's circuit encloses, so that circuit is laid across its deck;'. T-V6-47: 'a viaduct a later trace meets gets no gate' → 'its viaduct, which the METROPOLIS circuit meets, gets no gate on its deck, the main approach road's ground course taking that circuit's gate (gates counted on ground part 0)'.

issues.claim: V06 §8's E3 row (l. 4231) lands T-V6-11 and T-V6-73 at E3's exit ('T-V6-9–11, 46–49, 57–61, 73'). Two of their clauses topple supports: T-V6-73's station's-regrowth clause, new this round from the END of VAP-r4-01 ('both spans beside the aqueduct's crossing station toppled'), and T-V6-11's second run ('a scripted `topple` of the support next to the station on either side'), now on H-AQUA's CITY ring. `topple` is an event-only hazard operator (V06 §3.11.4) that E5 builds ('… supports toppled and scoured …', l. 4233), so neither clause can run at E3's exit. T-V6-11's sky clause ('on a sky fixture whose island falls at year 30 …; exact on the landfall fixture') needs V05's P6 `fallIsland`, and M6-sky lands after M6-U while M6-E starts right after M4. INDEX §5 risk 2 and R5-05 (c) move such clauses to the first exit after the provider, each named in its volume; V06's cell names none. Nothing built changes.
issues.required_change: V06 §8's E3 tests cell 'T-V6-9–11, 46–49, 57–61, 73' → 'T-V6-9–11, 46–49, 57–61, 73 (T-V6-11's runs on toppled supports and T-V6-73's station's regrowth at E5, which builds `topple`; T-V6-11's sky clause at the later of E3 and V05's P6, which builds the landfall)'. E5's tests cell 'T-V6-12, 16–20, 25, 27, 54 (raise), 72' adds ', T-V6-11's and T-V6-73's topple clauses'.
